ability.infinity.reality_stone.painted_s: Reality repaints the sky. Left: the sky above the area (radius from the scroll, 32 to 128 blocks) is painted from the zenith down to the horizon for 2 minutes, for every player inside it: Aurora with waving ribbons, Galaxy with nebulae and stars even at noon, Eternal Sunset, Blood Moon or Cotton Candy clouds. Right: pick the theme. Purely visual; ends on expiry or when you log out.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.genesis.d: The world is rewritten. Left (aim): a red wave runs across the terrain and truly changes the biome, permanently, in a column of radius 8 to 64 (scroll). The surface adapts: grass, sand, snow, mycelium, podzol, fitting plants and trees, water that freezes or dries. Other players' protected land is left alone. Right: pick the biome (any registered biome).
ability.infinity.soul_stone.wisp_guide.d: A living flame, orange and blue, appears and flies a few blocks ahead, guiding you to where you last died. It waits if you fall behind and vanishes on arrival, on reuse or on logout. If the spot is in another dimension, only you are told which. Right: guide to your bed/respawn point or to an online player in the same dimension. Scroll: speed.
ability.infinity.soul_stone.essence_harv: Left (aim at a player or creature): for 3 seconds, orange soul strands are pulled from the target into a soul orb floating at your side, carrying experience levels (scroll: 1 to 30) and magicules. The orb keeps everything and persists. Right: give the orb's whole contents to the aimed ally, or to yourself if you aim at nothing. Does not work inside other players' protected land.
